annotations.title: Google ads: Shopping, targeting, freshness and creatives

description: Everything on the app's Google Ads tab for your brand vs rivals, untrimmed: live, new and stopped ads, every country, Google Shopping, formats, targeting, creative freshness (median ad age, weekly series), all topics, where ads show, reach, alerts, advertiser accounts. Name exactly one brand to also get its Google creatives, 200 per page (creatives_offset for the next page; `total` tells how many exist). Up to 6 brands per call.

country.description: Optional ISO country code to focus on one market, e.g. "DE".

creatives_offset.description: With one brand: skip this many creatives (pages of 200). Default 0.

domains.description: Up to 6 brand domains from your RivalSweeper account. Omit for your own store plus your first tracked rivals. Name exactly one to include its creatives.

name: get_google_ads_shopping_targeting_and_creatives
